validation.title: Field checks
validation.description: Each extracted value is checked automatically. Open the source line to see where it came from.
validation.noEvidence: No source line was recorded for this value.
validation.warnBeforeConfirm: Some fields have warnings. Review them, then press Create bill again to continue.
validation.confirmMissingDate: No date was found on the document, so today's date was filled in. Change it or press Create bill again to keep it.
validation.confirmAmounts: The document amounts do not reconcile ({fields}). Check the lines against the document, then press Create bill again to continue.
validation.blockedInvalid: Correct these fields before creating the bill: {fields}

reasons.INVOICE_NUMBER_FORMAT: The invoice number has an unexpected format.
reasons.DATE_INVALID: The date is not a real calendar date.
reasons.DATE_TOO_OLD: The date is before the year 2000.
reasons.DATE_IN_FUTURE: The date is more than 7 days in the future.
reasons.DATE_AMBIGUOUS: Day and month could be swapped. Confirm the date.
reasons.CURRENCY_NOT_BASE: The currency differs from the organization base currency, so it cannot be posted.
reasons.AMOUNT_NOT_NUMERIC: The amount is not a number.
reasons.AMOUNT_PRECISION: The amount has more than 4 decimal places.
reasons.TOTALS_MISMATCH: Subtotal plus VAT does not equal the total.
reasons.VAT_RATE_UNEXPECTED: The VAT rate is not the standard rate for this country.
reasons.TAX_ID_FORMAT: The tax ID does not match the expected format for the country.
reasons.VENDOR_MATCHED_BY_TAX_ID: A vendor with this tax ID exists.
reasons.VENDOR_NOT_MATCHED: No vendor with this tax ID exists yet.
reasons.VENDOR_TAX_ID_MISSING: Cannot match a vendor without a tax ID.

intake.discrepancyTitle: Extracted totals do not match the computed totals

intake.streamUnavailable: This scan is no longer available. Please upload the document again.
intake.streamLostConnection: Lost connection while processing the document. Please try again.
